name: Bunny Land
description: Ten bunny-themed maps normalized to the shared project map catalog layout.

maps.name: Bunny Meadow
maps.theme: A simple open meadow for tutorial play: lots of tiny objects, wide paths, few hazards.

maps.name: Carrot Village
maps.theme: A gentle village with carrot cottages, garden plots, and clearer resource clusters.

maps.name: Bunny Burrow Park
maps.theme: A park with loops, playground props, hedge pockets, and the first moving hazard.

maps.name: Hopscotch Hills
maps.theme: Rolling hills with hopscotch bonus lanes, slopes, windmills, and split routes.

maps.name: Easter Garden
maps.theme: A denser Easter garden with hedge maze geometry, slippery egg tiles, and timed egg bursts.

maps.name: Bunny Bakery Town
maps.theme: A bakery town with streets, large edible buildings, market routes, and tighter sightlines.

maps.name: Whisker Wonderland
maps.theme: A playful wonderland full of curved lanes, tea party props, confusing surfaces, and busy bot traffic.

maps.name: Moonlit Burrows
maps.theme: A night cavern map with narrow bridges, crystal resources, pit zones, and shifting routes.

maps.name: Bunny Kingdom
maps.theme: A royal town with castle walls, guard patrols, locked gates, and high-value towers.

maps.name: The Great Bunny Citadel
maps.theme: The finale: a spiral citadel with moat hazards, towers, drawbridges, and a late-game throne unlock.
